shared_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a polished concept board for the Calgary Crocs underwater hockey club app, not a landing page. Two complete front-facing mobile app artboards side by side, on a quiet landscape presentation canvas. No physical devices, perspective, desk, promotional copy or giant captions. Small concept label outside screens. Keep Home and Feedback comparable to the previous exploration but make everything noticeably more minimal and realistically usable on a phone. Headers must be SHORT: brand row and page title, at most 15% of a screen's height. No large hero images or full-width decorative murals. No photographs, huge display type or generic dashboard bento grid. Preserve readable hierarchy and touch-sized buttons.
LEFT Home: small "CALGARY CROCS" brand row, heading "Hi Alex"; "Next practice"; compact date block "THU / 29 / OCT"; linked "Thursday training" plus chevron; "7:45–9:30 PM", "MNP Sport Centre". Three clean compact attendance rows: "You", "Sam", "Mila", with separate "Yes" and "No" buttons. You and Mila Yes selected green, Sam No selected restrained red. Real small buttons "Attendance", "Plan", "Teams" grouped on one row. Below, a quiet "Club news" row "Welcome to the new season". Bottom tabs Home, Schedule, Messages, Account, Club.
RIGHT Account: name "Alex Rivera", sibling tabs "Progress" and "Feedback", Feedback selected. Four clear sections without redundant nested card borders: "Your reflections" with "Reflect" button; "Coach ratings" with "Thursday training", "29 Oct" and "8/10"; "Coach notes" with "Great support play. Keep moving after the pass."; "Videos" with one compact row "Passing review" and a play icon. Bottom navigation same as Home, Account selected.
Both screens must feel built from one meticulous design system. No more than one main outlined panel per screen; use whitespace and fine dividers for the rest. No extra widgets, stock charts, money values, streaks, leaderboards, awards, coins or unrelated features. Uppercase avatar initials only. Do not draw hockey sticks, sports equipment, complex anatomy or underwater scenes. No watermark.

concepts.name: 06-minimal-illustrated
concepts.prompt: Concept label "06 / MINIMAL CLUBHOUSE". Input image 1 is only a reference for the earlier illustrated club concept; do not preserve its busy composition. Redesign with 75% less illustration and far fewer colored panels. Take broad inspiration from Duolingo's simple flat character geometry, friendly rounded sans typography, excellent whitespace and tactile, firm bottom-edge button shadows, but do NOT use Duolingo's owl, logo, characters, language-learning icons or exact branded layout. White/off-white background, deep charcoal-green text, lively leaf-green primary accent, a tiny periwinkle secondary accent only. One SMALL original friendly flat geometric crocodile head waving beside "Hi Alex", taking less than 8% of the screen, no large banner. Croc has simple charming eyes, no detailed limbs or equipment. Elsewhere only a few small bold flat icons, consistent outline thickness. Compact date tile, subtly rounded rectangles, selected Yes controls feel satisfyingly pressable with 2px darker bottom edge; neutral inactive controls stay quiet. Right Feedback screen has no decorative header character, no mural, no oversized section-icon disks. Keep illustration purposeful and sparse, strong readable type, welcoming for adults and children, confident not childish. Most surfaces white with whitespace, not pastel cards everywhere.

concepts.name: 07-rare-modern
concepts.prompt: Concept label "07 / RARE MODERN". Original interpretation inspired by Rare UI's tasteful, distinctive interaction components, not a copy of its website. Ultra-modern light product UI: cool porcelain and pearl-white surfaces, near-black precision typography, emerald and restrained cyan as accents, rounded geometric neo-grotesk, excellent fine alignment and balanced density. The only decorative accent is a SMALL 48px liquid-glass aquatic teal orb or sculptural water droplet at the Home header edge, referencing a fluid material component; it must not become a giant hero or occupy content space. Tiny refined optical-depth details in selected tab and button edges, hairline separators, soft contact shadows, engineered but understated materials. Date block is crisp and sculptural, controls feel refined and tactile rather than soft bubbly toy buttons. Mostly flat legible content. No illustrations, no mascots, no photography, no colored cards for every section. Minimalism with a very high level of craft, not an empty bland white SaaS wireframe. No decorative gradients across entire page, no glow clouds.

concepts.name: 08-fey-quiet-dark
concepts.prompt: Concept label "08 / QUIET PERFORMANCE". An original understated dark club UI inspired by the refined aesthetic associated with Fey Finance, adapted to sport without importing finance features or charts. Charcoal-black rather than blue cyberpunk; subtly layered graphite with barely perceptible warm top lighting, porcelain-white headings, generous readable gray secondary text, a very limited soft mint-green accent and muted red attendance state. Elegant small-scale neo-grotesk, precise tabular date/time numerals, beautifully restrained iconography and thin separators. Richness comes from immaculate hierarchy, beautiful proportions, subtle material light and focused accent color, not decoration. No photographs, illustration, mascot, giant title, hero panels, neon or glowing outlines. The single featured practice panel has a very subtle inset border and small date column. Attendance rows remain compact, Selected Yes uses a deep green fill with mint check and readable label, selected No a soft dark-red fill. Grouped Attendance / Plan / Teams actions are quiet small well-defined buttons, not giant CTAs. Feedback sections are open rows with one subtly illuminated note surface. Premium, calm, ultra-modern and approachable, not trading terminal density, not a finance dashboard.
